pose_constraints.posture: Strictly vertical 'Pillar' stance; head tilted slightly upward to maximize verticality.
pose_constraints.orientation: Direct 0-degree head-on frontal view. The nose horn is the center point.
pose_constraints.camera_angle: Low-angle 'Hero' shot, looking slightly up to emphasize the height of the frill.
pose_constraints.grounding: Standing on flat, dark green-grey mud; all four feet clustered tightly to avoid horizontal sprawl.
pose_constraints.body_logic: Torso, hips, and tail are completely occluded by the front chest and head. Silhouette must remain under 280px wide.
pose_constraints.framing_note: The forward-curling frill hooks must be symmetrical, forming the top edge of the 'pillar' silhouette.

character_details.expression: Signature inquisitive smirk; large, soulful eyes looking down toward the camera.
character_details.texture: Tactile leathery skin with vibrant, contrasting 'display colors' on the frill (oranges and teals).
features: Ornate frill with ten forward-curling hooks

environmental_details.ground: Saturated green-grey mud with subtle footprints and light-catching puddles.
flora: Tall giant horsetails (Equisetum) positioned directly behind the dinosaur to reinforce the vertical axis
environmental_details.sky: Warm, hazy afternoon sky providing a bright backlight to separate the frill hooks from the background.
environmental_details.lighting: High-key golden rim-lighting on the top edge of the frill.
